hypothesis: A credit income instead of energy may save one two-card currency exchange while paying for the same known full-scan card and free analysis. The baseline later discards the very credit-income card it preserves at the income menu.
stateEquivalence: Exact Native root, session, RNG, known cards and same literal scan/analysis targets; no synthetic funds or hand-subset search.
success: Verify the same native score/technology/scan/analysis endpoint with the exact income, currency and retained-card tradeoff; only then consider a shared income-funding quote.
candidateContract: On an exact primary utility tie, prefer the currency supplier that saves a known two-card exchange for an already-known paid full-scan/free-analysis purpose. No extra search node, income weight or credit priority.
stateDedupAndBudget: Existing complete Native identity, goal reachability and shared-prefix budgets unchanged. New ranking reads visible immutable facts only, never substitutes a Native successor.
stop: No full game before candidate cold gate; no20-board batch. Stop the candidate if required development regresses. No generic forecast tuning.

validationPhase.reason: Positive same-purpose Native witness and a failing-then-passing production-port test now justify the bounded implementation gate. This is the same funding-tie hypothesis, not a forecast sweep.
validationPhase.required: All cold points pass before any autonomous game; preserve complete teaching round assets before a single board5 run.
